{{Top|leg}}

A '''sonde balloon''' was a piece of equipment used to increase the range of communication devices. Consisting of a small balloon attached to a wire, it would lift communications equipment, such as an [[Antenna/Legends|antenna]], to an altitude that would enable it to clear ground-based obstacles. However, a sonde balloon is nondirectional, allowing anyone in the surrounding area to listen in if it is not encrypted.<ref name="Heir">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>

While hiding from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces in the forests of [[Myrkr]] during the beginning of the [[Thrawn campaign]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] and [[Luke Skywalker]] used a sonde balloon kept inside her [[Survival kit/Legends|survival kit]] to send an encrypted message back to [[Talon Karrde|Talon Karrde's]] nearby [[Myrkr Base]]. The high metallic content of trees native to Myrkr caused natural interference with [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] and communications equipment necessitating the use of a sonde balloon to rise above the forest canopy.<ref name="Heir" />
